consequence.statement: The GCP workload identity parameters are no longer required, so a provider configuration that omits them is accepted where it previously was not; the evidence describes no failure or removal of behaviour.
consequence.remediation: No operator action is described; review GCP provider configurations only if strict validation of the workload identity parameters was relied upon.

assertion.statement: In external-secrets 0.16.0 the GCP workload identity parameters become optional (i.e. they were previously mandatory to set), a change the release notes list under breaking changes.

proposal.undeterminedReason: subject: The evidence names only 'workload identity parameters' for GCP; it does not identify the affected fields (no CRD group/kind/paths, no Helm keys, and no artifact context is provided to settle their spelling), and 'parameters' plausibly covers several distinct fields.; applicability: The evidence does not name which parameters became optional (no field paths, CRD identity, or values), so no environment condition (e.g. which provider configuration to inspect) can be built from it.
